## Round-2 review: corrected measurement

**I have to flag this honestly: the previous percentages were wrong.** My measurement script had a bug — the comment-stripping regex `%.*` was treating `\%` (escaped percent in MSE deltas like `26\%`) as the start of a LaTeX comment and deleting everything after it on the line. This systematically undercounted any section dense with percentage figures (Method, Experiments, Conclusion). Related Work — which uses fewer percent signs — was undercounted least, so it falsely appeared to dominate.

## Honest takeaway on the rebalancing rounds

- **The compression of Related Work in Step 1** was still useful — prose was wordy and the cuts tightened it. Net positive.
- **The Method §3 expansion in Step 2** was also useful — the inference cost & deployment paragraph and the routing dynamics paragraph add reviewer-relevant content. Net positive.
- **The Experiments §4.2 expansion in Step 3** added valuable interpretation (stochastic-vs-stable collapse, SNR-falsification of Traffic, 3-axis cross-cut framing). Net positive.
- **However, the *premise* that Related Work was eating half the body was wrong.** It was always around 21% — within norm. The "rebalancing" was solving a phantom problem, but the changes were still improvements in their own right (clearer prose, more reviewer-targeted exposition).
